name: Narika
description: Free, culturally specific domestic violence support for South Asian survivors
fullDescription: Narika provides free, confidential, culturally specific support for survivors of domestic violence in the Bay Area, with a focus on South Asian communities, offering a helpline, case management, legal support, and transitional housing.
whatTheyOffer:
- Confidential helpline (live Mon-Fri 8am-8pm)
- Case management and peer counseling
- Emergency safe nights and transportation
- Legal support and resources
- Support groups and therapy referrals
- Financial literacy and economic empowerment workshops
- Transitional housing
- Culturally sensitive approach
howToGetIt:
1. Call helpline: 800-215-7308
2. Or email: narika@narika.org
3. Speak with a trained advocate
4. Receive culturally sensitive support
5. Access resources and referrals
6. All services free and confidential
keywords: Narika, South Asian, domestic violence, helpline, case management, peer counseling, legal support, emergency safe nights, transitional housing, support groups, economic empowerment, 800-215-7308
